title: CertGate model-channel output (reading.json); in this build produced only by MockReader
description: Validated in src/model-output.ts. Every numeric value is a string; a JSON number anywhere rejects the document (invalid_output). Unknown keys are ignored.

value.description: Decimal string for numeric fields (point or comma), text otherwise; null when status is unknown or absent

unit.description: % for chemistry and CEV; MPa or N/mm² for ReH and Rm; % for A; J for KV; °C for kv_temperature

status.description: read = value present; unknown = not readable with confidence; absent = not printed on the document

planted.description: true on a planted deviation (dataset only)

kv_temperature.description: Impact test temperature, e.g. "-20" with unit °C

explanation.description: Model free text. Recorded, never used by the decision.

planted.description: Planted deviations: kind misread | contamination | failure. Any entry makes the receipt's reading_source "planted".

mock_failure.description: MockReader failure injection. timeout, http_429 and http_5xx are retried twice (3 calls); endpoint_off and invalid_json are not (1 call). The call count is in receipt.reader.calls and ModelReader.calls.
